content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ABIOC(EDR-016 RunMRU Paste-Execution Seeding an Interpreter Download Cradle) AND ABIOC(EDR-016 explorer.exe-Parented Interpreter Launched with Remote-Fetch Arguments) AND (ABIOC(EDR-016 Interpreter-Spawned LOLBin Fetching a Remote Payload) OR XQL(EDR-016 Remote Payload Fetch to Latrodectus C2 Surfaced on the NGFW)) on the same agent_hostname within the paste-execution window — fuses the RunMRU download cradle, the explorer-parented interpreter with no browser or console parentage, and the remote-fetch LOLBin/NGFW egress into a single ClickFix user-execution incident spanning the EDR and NDR planes, anchored to the explorer.exe process instance.
rules.name: ClickFix Paste-Execution Chain — RunMRU to explorer-Parented Interpreter to LOLBin Fetch (ABIOC Causality Stitch)
